entries.name: KroneckerDelta.kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv
entries.docstring: The Kronecker delta is invariant under the component-index equivalence `finSumFinEquiv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma kroneckerDelta_finSumFinEquiv (a b : Fin 1 ⊕ Fin 3) :
    kroneckerDelta (finSumFinEquiv a) (finSumFinEquiv b) = kroneckerDelta a b

entries.name: Matrix.det_add_rankOne_aux
entries.docstring:
Expanding the determinant of a rank-one row update over a finite set of rows.
For `i ∈ s` the row `A i` is replaced by `A i + w i • b`; the other rows are untouched.
entries.snippet:
private lemma det_add_rankOne_aux {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] {R : Type*}
    [CommRing R] (A : Matrix ι ι R) (w b : ι → R) (s : Finset ι) :
    (A + Matrix.of fun i j => (if i ∈ s then w i else 0) * b j).det
      = A.det + ∑ i ∈ s, w i * (A.updateRow i b).det

entries.name: Matrix.det_add_rankOne
entries.docstring:
**Rank-one determinant update** (the ring-general matrix determinant lemma for an outer
product, valid even when `A` is singular). Adding the rank-one matrix `w ⊗ b` to `A` changes the
determinant by `∑ i, w i * det (A.updateRow i b)`.

Mathlib only provides this when `det A` is a unit (`Matrix.det_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow`);
the singular case is needed here because Kronecker-delta matrices are typically singular.

entries.name: generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul
entries.docstring:
The product of two Levi-Civita-type symbols is a generalized Kronecker delta:
`δ^{μ}_{·} · δ^{ν}_{·} = δ^{μ}_{ν}`, where each single factor is a Kronecker matrix against the
identity. This is the Lean form of `ε^{μ₁…μₙ} ε_{ν₁…νₙ} = δ^{μ₁…μₙ}_{ν₁…νₙ}`.
entries.snippet:
lemma generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul (μ ν : α → α) :
    generalizedKroneckerDelta μ id * generalizedKroneckerDelta ν id
      = generalizedKroneckerDelta μ ν

entries.name: generalizedKroneckerDelta_sum_snoc
entries.docstring:
**Generalized Kronecker delta contraction.** Summing a `generalizedKroneckerDelta` over one
shared index appended at the end lowers the rank by one and pulls out a factor of `card α - n`.
This is the reusable combinatorial fact behind all epsilon-epsilon identities.
entries.snippet:
lemma generalizedKroneckerDelta_sum_snoc {n : ℕ} (μ ν : Fin n → α) :
    ∑ a : α, generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.snoc μ a) (Fin.snoc ν a)
      = ((Fintype.card α : ℤ) - n) * generalizedKroneckerDelta μ ν

entries.name: sum_over_snoc
entries.docstring: Split a sum over `(k+1)`-tuples into the last entry and the initial `k`-tuple.

entries.name: sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_self
entries.docstring:
**Full contraction.** Iterating the snoc contraction over all four indices:
`∑_f δ^{f}_{f} = 4!`. Here `f` ranges over all maps `Fin 4 → Fin 4`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_self (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ h : Fin k → Fin 4, generalizedKroneckerDelta h h
      = ∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((4 : ℤ) - j)

entries.name: sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_cons
entries.docstring:
**Single contraction.** Contracting the last `k` of `k+1` index pairs leaves one free pair
`σ, τ`, with the factorial factor `(4-1)(4-2)…`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_cons (σ τ : Fin 4) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ h : Fin k → Fin 4,
        generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.cons σ h) (Fin.cons τ h)
      = (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((3 : ℤ) - j)) * ((kroneckerDelta σ τ : ℕ) : ℤ)

entries.name: sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_cons₂
entries.docstring:
**Double contraction.** Contracting the last `k` of `k+2` index pairs leaves two free pairs,
with value a `2×2` generalized Kronecker delta times the factorial factor.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_cons₂ (ρ σ τ ω : Fin 4) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ h : Fin k → Fin 4,
        generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.cons ρ (Fin.cons σ h)) (Fin.cons τ (Fin.cons ω h))
      = (∏ j ∈ Finset.range k, ((2 : ℤ) - j))
        * generalizedKroneckerDelta ![ρ, σ] ![τ, ω]

entries.name: sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul_self
entries.docstring: Symbol-level full contraction over `Fin 4 → Fin 4`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul_self :
    ∑ g : Fin 4 → Fin 4,
      generalizedKroneckerDelta g id * generalizedKroneckerDelta g id = (24 : ℤ)

entries.name: sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul_cons
entries.docstring: Symbol-level triple contraction, one free pair `σ, τ`.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul_cons (σ τ : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 3 → Fin 4,
        generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.cons σ h) id
          * generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.cons τ h) id
      = 6 * ((kroneckerDelta σ τ : ℕ) : ℤ)

entries.name: sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul_cons₂
entries.docstring: Symbol-level double contraction, two free pairs.
entries.snippet:
lemma sum_generalizedKroneckerDelta_mul_cons₂ (ρ σ τ ω : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 2 → Fin 4,
        generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.cons ρ (Fin.cons σ h)) id
          * generalizedKroneckerDelta (Fin.cons τ (Fin.cons ω h)) id
      = 2 * (((kroneckerDelta ρ τ : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((kroneckerDelta σ ω : ℕ) : ℤ)
          - ((kroneckerDelta ρ ω : ℕ) : ℤ) * ((kroneckerDelta σ τ : ℕ) : ℤ))

entries.name: Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec_orthogonal
entries.docstring:
An orthogonal matrix preserves the dot product: if `Aᵀ A = 1` then `(A v) ⬝ᵥ (A w) = v ⬝ᵥ w`.
Taking `w = v` shows orthogonal matrices preserve squared lengths, `(A v) ⬝ᵥ (A v) = v ⬝ᵥ v`.
entries.snippet:
lemma dotProduct_mulVec_orthogonal {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {n : Type*} [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] {A : Matrix n n R} (hA : Aᵀ * A = 1) (v w : n → R) :
    (A *ᵥ v) ⬝ᵥ (A *ᵥ w) = v ⬝ᵥ w

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.mem_resolventSet_of_im_ne_zero
entries.docstring:
Every real number lies in the `ℝ`-resolvent set of a non-real complex number:
`t - z` is invertible for all `t : ℝ`.
entries.snippet: lemma mem_resolventSet_of_im_ne_zero (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) : t ∈ resolventSet ℝ z

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.resolventSet_eq_univ
entries.docstring: The `ℝ`-resolvent set of a non-real complex number is all of `ℝ`.
entries.snippet: lemma resolventSet_eq_univ (hz : z.im ≠ 0) : resolventSet ℝ z = Set.univ

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.norm_resolvent_le
entries.docstring:
The resolvent is globally bounded by `|z.im|⁻¹`: the imaginary part of the denominator
`t - z` is exactly `-z.im`.
entries.snippet: lemma norm_resolvent_le (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (t : ℝ) : ‖resolvent z t‖ ≤ |z.im|⁻¹

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.contDiff_resolvent
entries.docstring: The resolvent of a non-real complex number is smooth along `ℝ`.
entries.snippet:
@[fun_prop]
lemma contDiff_resolvent (hz : z.im ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (resolvent (R := ℝ) z)

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.iteratedDeriv_resolvent
entries.docstring:
Closed form for the iterated derivatives of the resolvent: the `n`-th derivative is
`(-1)ⁿ · n! · (resolvent z)ⁿ⁺¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma iteratedDeriv_resolvent (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv n (resolvent (R := ℝ) z)
      = fun t ↦ (-1) ^ n * (n ! : ℂ) * resolvent z t ^ (n + 1)

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.norm_iteratedDeriv_resolvent_le
entries.docstring:
Every iterated derivative of the resolvent is globally bounded, explicitly by
`n! · (|z.im| ^ (n + 1))⁻¹`.
entries.snippet:
lemma norm_iteratedDeriv_resolvent_le (hz : z.im ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv n (resolvent z) t‖ ≤ n ! * (|z.im| ^ (n + 1))⁻¹

entries.name: Physlib.Resolvent.hasTemperateGrowth_resolvent
entries.docstring: The resolvent of a non-real complex number has temperate growth along `ℝ`.
entries.snippet:
@[fun_prop]
lemma hasTemperateGrowth_resolvent (hz : z.im ≠ 0) :
    Function.HasTemperateGrowth (resolvent (R := ℝ) z)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite
entries.docstring:
The physicist's Hermite polynomials are defined as polynomials over `ℤ` in `X` recursively
  with `physHermite 0 = 1` and

  `physHermite (n + 1) = 2 • X * physHermite n - derivative (physHermite n)`.

  This polynomial will often be cast as a function `ℝ → ℝ` by evaluating the polynomial at `X`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def physHermite : ℕ → Polynomial ℤ
  | 0 => 1
  | n + 1 => 2 • X * physHermite n - derivative (physHermite n)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_succ
entries.docstring: The defining recursion `physHermite (n + 1) = (2x - d/dx) (physHermite n)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_succ (n : ℕ) :
    physHermite (n + 1) = 2 • X * physHermite n - derivative (physHermite n)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_eq_iterate
entries.docstring: The Rodrigues formula `physHermite n = (2x - d/dx)ⁿ 1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_eq_iterate (n : ℕ) :
    physHermite n = (fun p => 2 * X * p - derivative p)^[n] 1

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma physHermite_zero : physHermite 0 = C 1

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma physHermite_one : physHermite 1 = 2 * X

entries.name: Polynomial.derivative_physHermite_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma derivative_physHermite_succ : (n : ℕ) →
    derivative (physHermite (n + 1)) = 2 * (n + 1) • physHermite n
  | 0 => by simp [physHermite_one]
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [physHermite_succ]
    simp only [derivative_physHermite_succ n, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_add,
      Nat.cast_one, derivative_sub, derivative_mul, derivative_ofNat, zero_mul, derivative_X,
      mul_one, zero_add, derivative_add, derivative_natCast, derivative_one, add_zero]
    simp only [physHermite_succ, nsmul_eq_mul]
    ring

entries.name: Polynomial.derivative_physHermite
entries.snippet:
lemma derivative_physHermite : (n : ℕ) →
    derivative (physHermite n) = 2 * n • physHermite (n - 1)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by simp [derivative_physHermite_succ]

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_succ'
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_succ' (n : ℕ) :
    physHermite (n + 1) = 2 • X * physHermite n - 2 * n • physHermite (n - 1)

entries.name: Polynomial.coeff_physHermite_succ_zero
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_physHermite_succ_zero (n : ℕ) :
    coeff (physHermite (n + 1)) 0 = - coeff (physHermite n) 1

entries.name: Polynomial.coeff_physHermite_succ_succ
entries.snippet:
lemma coeff_physHermite_succ_succ (n k : ℕ) : coeff (physHermite (n + 1)) (k + 1) =
    2 * coeff (physHermite n) k - (k + 2) * coeff (physHermite n) (k + 2)

entries.name: Polynomial.coeff_physHermite_of_lt
entries.snippet: lemma coeff_physHermite_of_lt {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n < k) : coeff (physHermite n) k = 0

entries.name: Polynomial.coeff_physHermite_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma coeff_physHermite_self (n : ℕ) : coeff (physHermite n) n = 2 ^ n

entries.name: Polynomial.degree_physHermite
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma degree_physHermite (n : ℕ) : degree (physHermite n) = n

entries.name: Polynomial.natDegree_physHermite
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma natDegree_physHermite (n : ℕ) : (physHermite n).natDegree = n

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_leadingCoeff
entries.snippet:

lemma physHermite_leadingCoeff (n : ℕ) : (physHermite n).leadingCoeff = 2 ^ n

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_ne_zero
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma physHermite_ne_zero (n : ℕ) : physHermite n ≠ 0

entries.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_physHermite_of_gt
entries.snippet:
lemma iterate_derivative_physHermite_of_gt {n m : ℕ} (h : n < m) :

entries.name: Polynomial.iterate_derivative_physHermite_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma iterate_derivative_physHermite_self (n : ℕ) :
    derivative^[n] (physHermite n) = C (n ! * 2 ^ n : ℤ)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_zero_coe
entries.snippet: lemma physHermite_zero_coe : (physHermite 0 : ℝ → ℝ) = fun _ ↦ 1

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_succ_coe
entries.docstring: The defining recursion for `physHermite` as functions `ℝ → ℝ` (c.f. `physHermite_succ`).
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_succ_coe (n : ℕ) :
    (physHermite (n + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) =
      2 • (fun x => x) * (physHermite n : ℝ → ℝ) - deriv (physHermite n)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_succ_apply
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_succ_apply (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    physHermite (n + 1) x = 2 * x * physHermite n x - deriv (physHermite n) x

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_succ_coe'
entries.docstring: The two-term recursion for `physHermite` as functions `ℝ → ℝ` (c.f. `physHermite_succ'`).
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_succ_coe' (n : ℕ) :
    (physHermite (n + 1) : ℝ → ℝ) =
      2 • (fun x => x) * (physHermite n : ℝ → ℝ) - (2 * n) • (physHermite (n - 1) : ℝ → ℝ)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_succ_apply'
entries.snippet:
lemma physHermite_succ_apply' (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    physHermite (n + 1) x = 2 * x * physHermite n x - 2 * n * physHermite (n - 1) x

entries.name: Polynomial.deriv_physHermite
entries.snippet: lemma deriv_physHermite (n : ℕ) : deriv (physHermite n) = 2 * n * physHermite (n - 1)

entries.name: Polynomial.iterate_deriv_physHermite_eq_iterate_derivative

lemma iterate_deriv_physHermite_eq_iterate_derivative (n m : ℕ) :

entries.name: Polynomial.fderiv_physHermite

lemma fderiv_physHermite (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (physHermite n) x = (1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (deriv (physHermite n) x)

entries.name: Polynomial.deriv_gaussian_eq_physHermite_mul_gaussian
entries.snippet:
lemma deriv_gaussian_eq_physHermite_mul_gaussian (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    deriv^[n] (fun y => Real.exp (- y ^ 2)) x =
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ n * physHermite n x * Real.exp (- x ^ 2)

entries.name: Polynomial.physHermite_eq_deriv_gaussian

entries.name: Polynomial.guassian_integrable_polynomial_cons

entries.name: Polynomial.guassian_integrable_polynomial
entries.snippet:
@[fun_prop]
lemma guassian_integrable_polynomial {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (P : Polynomial ℤ) :

entries.name: Polynomial.integral_physHermite_mul_physHermite_eq_integral_deriv_exp
entries.snippet:
lemma integral_physHermite_mul_physHermite_eq_integral_deriv_exp (n m : ℕ) :
    ∫ x : ℝ, (physHermite n x * physHermite m x) * Real.exp (-x ^ 2) =
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ m * ∫ x : ℝ, (physHermite n x * (deriv^[m] fun x => Real.exp (-x ^ 2)) x)

entries.name: Polynomial.integral_physHermite_mul_physHermite_eq_integral_deriv_inductive
entries.snippet:
lemma integral_physHermite_mul_physHermite_eq_integral_deriv_inductive (n m : ℕ) :
    (p : ℕ) → (hpm : p ≤ m) →
    ∫ x : ℝ, (physHermite n x * physHermite m x) * Real.exp (- x ^ 2) =
    (-1 : ℝ) ^ (m - p) * ∫ x : ℝ, (deriv^[p] (physHermite n) x *
    (deriv^[m - p] fun x => Real.exp (-x ^ 2)) x)
  | 0, h => integral_physHermite_mul_physHermite_eq_integral_deriv_exp n m
  | p + 1, h => by
    rw [integral_physHermite_mul_physHermite_eq_integral_deriv_inductive n m p (by omega),
      show m - p = m - (p + 1) + 1 by omega, Function.iterate_succ_apply', pow_succ, mul_assoc,
      Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    congr
    have hl : ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv^[p] (physHermite n) x *
        deriv (deriv^[m - (p + 1)] fun x => Real.exp (-x ^ 2)) x =
        - ∫ (x : ℝ), deriv (deriv^[p] (physHermite n)) x *
        deriv^[m - (p + 1)] (fun x => Real.exp (-x ^ 2)) x

    ∫ x : ℝ, (physHermite n x * physHermite m x) * Real.exp (- x ^ 2) =
    ∫ x : ℝ, (deriv^[m] (physHermite n) x * (Real.exp (-x ^ 2)))

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_tmul
entries.docstring: The gauge action on a pure spinor–colour tensor.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul (g : GaugeGroupI) (ψ : Fermion.RightHandedWeyl)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)) :
    repGaugeGroupI g ⟨ψ ⊗ₜ v⟩ =

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum
entries.docstring: Expands the gauge action in the spinor–colour basis.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum (g : GaugeGroupI) (k : Fin 2) (i : Fin 3) :
    repGaugeGroupI g
      ⟨RightHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ i⟩ =
      ∑ i' : Fin 3, (star g.toU1.1 ^ 2 * g.toSU3.1 i' i) •
        (⟨RightHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ]
          EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ i'⟩ : DownSinglet)

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq
entries.docstring:
Two gauge elements induce the same action exactly when their hypercharge–colour coefficients
agree.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq {g₁ g₂ : GaugeGroupI} :
    repGaugeGroupI g₁ = repGaugeGroupI g₂ ↔ ∀ i i',
      star g₁.toU1.1 ^ 2 * g₁.toSU3.1 i' i =
        star g₂.toU1.1 ^ 2 * g₂.toSU3.1 i' i

entries.name: StandardModel.DownSinglet.mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq
entries.docstring: Characterizes the full-group elements acting trivially on the down-type singlet.

lemma mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq {g : GaugeGroupI} :
    g ∈ repGaugeGroupI.ker ↔ ∃ a : ℂ,
      g.toSU3.1 = a • 1 ∧ a * star g.toU1.1 ^ 2 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_tmul
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul (g : GaugeGroupI) (ψ : Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 3)) (w : EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 2)) :
    repGaugeGroupI g ⟨ψ ⊗ₜ v ⊗ₜ w⟩ = ⟨g.toU1 • ψ ⊗ₜ (g.toSU3.1.toEuclideanLin v) ⊗ₜ
      (g.toSU2.1.toEuclideanLin w)⟩

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The action of the full gauge group on a tensor product of basis elements, expanded as a
  sum over the columns of the `SU(3)` and `SU(2)` matrices.
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum (g : GaugeGroupI) (k : Fin 2) (i : Fin 3) (j : Fin 2) :
    repGaugeGroupI g ⟨LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ i
      ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℂ j⟩ =
      ∑ i' : Fin 3, ∑ j' : Fin 2, (g.toU1.1 * g.toSU3.1 i' i * g.toSU2.1 j' j)
      • (⟨LeftHandedWeyl.basis k ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℂ i'
          ⊗ₜ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℂ j'⟩ : QuarkDoublet)

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma repGaugeGroupI_eq_iff_mul_eq {g1 g2 : GaugeGroupI} :
    repGaugeGroupI g1 = repGaugeGroupI g2 ↔ ∀ i i' j j',
    g1.toU1.1 * g1.toSU3.1 i' i * g1.toSU2.1 j' j =
    g2.toU1.1 * g2.toSU3.1 i' i * g2.toSU2.1 j' j

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_repGaugeGroupI_ker_iff_eq {g : GaugeGroupI} :
    g ∈ repGaugeGroupI.ker ↔ ∃ a b : ℂ, g.toSU2.1 = a • 1 ∧ g.toSU3.1 = b • 1 ∧
      a * b * g.toU1.1 = 1

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_ℤ₆_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI :
    GaugeGroupQuot.subgroup .ℤ₆ ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI
entries.snippet:
lemma gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) :
    Q.subgroup ≤ repGaugeGroupI.ker

entries.name: StandardModel.QuarkDoublet.repGaugeGroup
entries.docstring:
The action of the Standard Model gauge group, potentially quotiented by
  a discrete factor on quark fields.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def repGaugeGroup : (Q : GaugeGroupQuot) →
    Representation ℂ (GaugeGroup Q) QuarkDoublet
  | .I => repGaugeGroupI
  | .ℤ₆ => QuotientGroup.lift _ repGaugeGroupI (gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI .ℤ₆)
  | .ℤ₂ => QuotientGroup.lift _ repGaugeGroupI (gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI .ℤ₂)
  | .ℤ₃ => QuotientGroup.lift _ repGaugeGroupI (gaugeGroup_subgroup_le_ker_repGaugeGroupI .ℤ₃)

entries.name: StandardModel.UpSinglet.repGaugeGroupI_tmul_basis_eq_sum
entries.docstring:
The action of the full gauge group on a tensor product of basis elements, expanded as a

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_domain_eq_top
entries.docstring: The multiplication operator of a `μ`-a.e. bounded function has full domain.

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_domain_antitone
entries.docstring: The domains of multiplication operators shrink with increasing function norm.

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_domain_eq_of_congr_norm
entries.docstring:
The multiplication operators corresponding to functions
  of `μ`-a.e. equal norm have the same domain.

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_isClosed
entries.docstring: Multiplication operators of `μ`-a.e. strongly measurable functions are closed.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_isClosed {μ : Measure (Space d)} [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ]
    {f : Space d → ℂ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) :
    (𝓜 μ f).IsClosed

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_zero
entries.docstring: The multiplication operator of the zero function is the zero operator (domain `⊤`).
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mulOperator_zero (μ : Measure (Space d)) : 𝓜 μ 0 = 0

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_eq_of_congr_ae
entries.docstring: `μ`-a.e. equal functions give rise to the same multiplication operator.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_eq_of_congr_ae {μ : Measure (Space d)} {f g : Space d → ℂ} (h : f =ᵐ[μ] g) :
    𝓜 μ f = 𝓜 μ g

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_const_smul_ge
entries.docstring:
Scalar multiplication and `mulOperator` commute except possibly for `c = 0`
  where the domains of `0 • 𝓜 μ f` and `𝓜 μ 0 = 0` may not agree.

  See `mulOperator_const_smul_eq` for equality when `c ≠ 0`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_const_smul_ge (μ : Measure (Space d)) (f : Space d → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    c • 𝓜 μ f ≤ 𝓜 μ (c • f)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_const_smul_eq
entries.docstring: Scalar multiplication and `mulOperator` commute for `c ≠ 0`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mulOperator_const_smul_eq (μ : Measure (Space d)) (f : Space d → ℂ) {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    𝓜 μ (c • f) = c • 𝓜 μ f

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_neg
entries.docstring: Negation and `mulOperator` commute.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mulOperator_neg (μ : Measure (Space d)) (f : Space d → ℂ) : 𝓜 μ (-f) = -𝓜 μ f

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_add_ge
entries.docstring:
`𝓜 μ (f + g)` extends `𝓜 μ f + 𝓜 μ g`.

  In general the domains do not match: `ψ ∈ (𝓜 μ f + 𝓜 μ g).domain` amounts to `MemHS (f • ψ) μ`
  _and_ `MemHS (g • ψ) μ` whereas `ψ ∈ (𝓜 μ (f + g)).domain` is equivalent to the weaker condition
  `MemHS ((f + g) • ψ) μ`.

  See `mulOperator_add_eq` and `mulOperator_add_eq'` for sufficient conditions
  to ensure equality.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_add_ge (μ : Measure (Space d)) (f g : Space d → ℂ) :
    𝓜 μ f + 𝓜 μ g ≤ 𝓜 μ (f + g)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_add_eq
entries.docstring: `(𝓜 μ g).domain = ⊤` is a sufficient condition to ensure equality in `mulOperator_add_ge`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mulOperator_add_eq
    {μ : Measure (Space d)} (f : Space d → ℂ) {g : Space d → ℂ} (h : (𝓜 μ g).domain = ⊤) :
    𝓜 μ (f + g) = 𝓜 μ f + 𝓜 μ g

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_add_eq'
entries.docstring:
Having both `‖f x‖ ≤ c * ‖f x + g x‖` and `‖g x‖ ≤ c' * ‖f x + g x‖` `μ`-a.e. is a sufficient
  condition to ensure equality in `mulOperator_add_ge`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_add_eq' {μ : Measure (Space d)}
    {f g : Space d → ℂ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ)
    (c c' : ℝ) (hf' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖ ≤ c * ‖f x + g x‖) (hg' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖g x‖ ≤ c' * ‖f x + g x‖) :
    𝓜 μ (f + g) = 𝓜 μ f + 𝓜 μ g

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_sub_ge
entries.docstring:
`𝓜 μ (f - g)` extends `𝓜 μ f - 𝓜 μ g`.

  In general the domains do not match: `ψ ∈ (𝓜 μ f - 𝓜 μ g).domain` amounts to `MemHS (f • ψ) μ`
  _and_ `MemHS (g • ψ) μ` whereas `ψ ∈ (𝓜 μ (f - g)).domain` is equivalent to the weaker condition
  `MemHS ((f - g) • ψ) μ`.

  See `mulOperator_sub_eq` and `mulOperator_sub_eq'` for sufficient conditions
  to ensure equality.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_sub_ge (μ : Measure (Space d)) (f g : Space d → ℂ) :
    𝓜 μ f - 𝓜 μ g ≤ 𝓜 μ (f - g)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_sub_eq
entries.docstring: `(𝓜 μ g).domain = ⊤` is a sufficient condition to ensure equality in `mulOperator_sub_ge`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mulOperator_sub_eq
    {μ : Measure (Space d)} (f : Space d → ℂ) {g : Space d → ℂ} (h : (𝓜 μ g).domain = ⊤) :
    𝓜 μ (f - g) = 𝓜 μ f - 𝓜 μ g

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_sub_eq'
entries.docstring:
Having both `‖f x‖ ≤ c * ‖f x - g x‖` and `‖g x‖ ≤ c' * ‖f x - g x‖` `μ`-a.e. is a sufficient
  condition to ensure equality in `mulOperator_sub_ge`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_sub_eq' {μ : Measure (Space d)}
    {f g : Space d → ℂ} (hf : AEStronglyMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g μ)
    (c c' : ℝ) (hf' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖f x‖ ≤ c * ‖f x - g x‖) (hg' : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖g x‖ ≤ c' * ‖f x - g x‖) :
    𝓜 μ (f - g) = 𝓜 μ f - 𝓜 μ g

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_smul_ge
entries.docstring:
`𝓜 μ (f • g)` extends `𝓜 μ f * 𝓜 μ g`.

  In general the domains do not match: `ψ ∈ (𝓜 μ f * 𝓜 μ g).domain`
  amounts to `MemHS (g • ψ) μ` _and_ `MemHS (f • g • ψ) μ` whereas
  `ψ ∈ (𝓜 μ (f • g)).domain` only requires `MemHS (f • g • ψ) μ`.

  See `mulOperator_smul_eq` for a sufficient condition to ensure equality.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_smul_ge (μ : Measure (Space d)) (f g : Space d → ℂ) :
    𝓜 μ f ∘ᵣ 𝓜 μ g ≤ 𝓜 μ (f • g)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.mulOperator_smul_eq
entries.docstring: `(𝓜 μ g).domain = ⊤` is a sufficient condition to ensure equality in `mulOperator_smul_ge`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mulOperator_smul_eq
    {μ : Measure (Space d)} (f : Space d → ℂ) {g : Space d → ℂ} (h : (𝓜 μ g).domain = ⊤) :
    𝓜 μ f ∘ᵣ 𝓜 μ g = 𝓜 μ (f • g)

entries.name: QuantumMechanics.OneDimension.UnboundedOperator.IsSymmetric
entries.docstring:
The condition for an unbounded operator to be *symmetric* (equivalently, formally
self-adjoint): `⟪U ψ1, ι ψ2⟫ = ⟪ι ψ1, U ψ2⟫` for all `ψ1 ψ2`. This is the Hermitian
pairing on the underlying space `S`; on its own it does **not** imply genuine
self-adjointness (`A† = A`, including equality of domains), which for an unbounded
operator on a proper dense core is strictly stronger.
entries.snippet: def IsSymmetric : Prop

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsSelfAdjoint.sub_smul_surjective
entries.docstring:
A self-adjoint operator has `T - z • 1` surjective for every non-real `z`: off the real
axis a self-adjoint operator has `z` in its resolvent set, so `T - z • 1` has full range.
entries.snippet: lemma sub_smul_surjective {z : ℂ} (hz : z.im ≠ 0) : Function.Surjective (T - z • 1).toFun

entries.name: LinearPMap.unitaryConj_isSelfAdjoint
entries.docstring:
Unitary conjugation preserves self-adjointness: if `A` is a self-adjoint operator on `H` and
`u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H'` is unitary, then `u A u⁻¹` is self-adjoint on `H'`. Symmetry, dense domain, and
the two deficiency surjectivities of `A` all transfer through `u`.
entries.snippet:
lemma unitaryConj_isSelfAdjoint (u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H') {A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hA : IsSelfAdjoint A) :
    IsSelfAdjoint (A.unitaryConj u)

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsSymmetric.isEssentiallySelfAdjoint_of_defectNumber_eq_zero
entries.docstring:
The basic criterion for essential self-adjointness: a symmetric, densely-defined operator
whose defect numbers at `I` and `-I` both vanish is essentially self-adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma isEssentiallySelfAdjoint_of_defectNumber_eq_zero
    (hdense : T.HasDenseDomain) (hpos : T.defectNumber I = 0) (hneg : T.defectNumber (-I) = 0) :
    T.IsEssentiallySelfAdjoint

entries.name: LinearPMap.isStarNormal_def
entries.snippet: lemma isStarNormal_def [CompleteSpace H] : IsStarNormal T ↔ T† * T = T * T†

entries.name: LinearPMap.adjoint_domain_of_continuous
entries.snippet: lemma adjoint_domain_of_continuous [CompleteSpace H] (h : Continuous U) : U†.domain = ⊤

entries.name: LinearPMap.HasDenseDomain.adjoint_add_continuous
entries.snippet:
lemma HasDenseDomain.adjoint_add_continuous [CompleteSpace H]
    (h₁ : T₁.HasDenseDomain) (h₂ : Continuous T₂) (h : T₁.domain ≤ T₂.domain) :
    (T₁ + T₂)† = T₁† + T₂†

entries.name: LinearPMap.HasDenseDomain.adjoint_sub_continuous

lemma HasDenseDomain.adjoint_sub_continuous [CompleteSpace H]
    (h₁ : T₁.HasDenseDomain) (h₂ : Continuous T₂) (h : T₁.domain ≤ T₂.domain) :
    (T₁ - T₂)† = T₁† - T₂†

entries.name: LinearPMap.unitaryConj
entries.docstring:
The conjugation `u A u⁻¹` of a partially-defined operator `A : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H` by a unitary
`u : H ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] H'`, with domain `u (A.domain) = u⁻¹ ⁻¹' (A.domain)` and action
`y ↦ u (A (u⁻¹ y))`. Since `u` and `u⁻¹` are `ℂ`-linear, the result is again `ℂ`-linear.
entries.snippet: def unitaryConj : H' →ₗ.[ℂ] H' where

entries.name: LinearPMap.mem_unitaryConj_domain_iff
entries.docstring: Membership in the conjugated domain: `x ∈ D(u A u⁻¹) ↔ u⁻¹ x ∈ D(A)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma mem_unitaryConj_domain_iff {x : H'} :
    x ∈ (unitaryConj u A).domain ↔ u.symm x ∈ A.domain

entries.name: LinearPMap.unitaryConj_apply
entries.docstring: The defining formula `(u A u⁻¹) x = u (A (u⁻¹ x))`.
entries.snippet:
lemma unitaryConj_apply (x : (unitaryConj u A).domain) :
    unitaryConj u A x = u (A ⟨u.symm (x : H'), (mem_unitaryConj_domain_iff u A).mp x.2⟩)

entries.name: LinearPMap.map_mem_unitaryConj_domain
entries.docstring: `u` maps `D(A)` into `D(u A u⁻¹)`.
entries.snippet: lemma map_mem_unitaryConj_domain (y : A.domain) : u (y : H) ∈ (unitaryConj u A).domain

entries.name: LinearPMap.unitaryConj_apply_map
entries.docstring: The action on the image domain: `(u A u⁻¹)(u y) = u (A y)` for `y ∈ D(A)`.
entries.snippet:
lemma unitaryConj_apply_map (y : A.domain) :
    unitaryConj u A ⟨u (y : H), map_mem_unitaryConj_domain u A y⟩ = u (A y)

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsFormalAdjoint.unitaryConj
entries.docstring:
Unitary conjugation preserves formal adjointness. If `A` is a formal adjoint of `B`, then
`u A u⁻¹` is a formal adjoint of `u B u⁻¹`. Unitary conjugation preserves symmetry when `A = B`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsFormalAdjoint.unitaryConj {B : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (h : A.IsFormalAdjoint B) :
    (unitaryConj u A).IsFormalAdjoint (unitaryConj u B)

entries.name: LinearPMap.HasDenseDomain.unitaryConj_dense_domain
entries.docstring:
If `A` has dense domain, then so does `u A u⁻¹`: the domain `u⁻¹ ⁻¹' (A.domain)` is the
preimage of a dense set under a homeomorphism.
entries.snippet:
lemma HasDenseDomain.unitaryConj_dense_domain (hdense : A.HasDenseDomain) :
    (unitaryConj u A).HasDenseDomain

entries.name: LinearPMap.unitaryConj_sub_smul_surjective
entries.docstring: If `A - z` is surjective for a scalar `z : ℂ`, then so is `u A u⁻¹ - z`.
entries.snippet:
lemma unitaryConj_sub_smul_surjective {z : ℂ} (h : Function.Surjective (A - z • 1).toFun) :
    Function.Surjective (unitaryConj u A - z • 1).toFun

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsSymmetric.closure_le_adjoint

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsSymmetric.isEssentiallySelfAdjoint_iff
entries.snippet:
lemma IsSymmetric.isEssentiallySelfAdjoint_iff [CompleteSpace H]

    T.IsEssentiallySelfAdjoint ↔ T†.domain = T.closure.domain

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsSymmetric.closure
entries.docstring:
The closure of a symmetric densely-defined operator is symmetric: `T††` is a symmetric
closed extension of `T`, so it extends `T.closure`, whose symmetry then descends.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsSymmetric.closure [CompleteSpace H] (hsym : T.IsSymmetric) (hdense : T.HasDenseDomain) :
    T.closure.IsSymmetric

entries.name: LinearPMap.IsSymmetric.isSelfAdjoint_of_range_eq_top
entries.docstring:
Self-adjointness from surjectivity of `T ± i`: a symmetric, densely-defined operator `T` for
which `T + I • 1` and `T - I • 1` both have full range is self-adjoint.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsSymmetric.isSelfAdjoint_of_range_eq_top [CompleteSpace H] (hsym : T.IsSymmetric)
    (hdense : T.HasDenseDomain)

    IsSelfAdjoint T

The linear equivalence `rightHandedWeylDualEquiv` is equivariant with respect to the action of

informal_lemma RightHandedWeyl.dualEquiv_equivariant where

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis_apply
entries.snippet: lemma basis_apply (i j : Fin 2) : (basis i).1 j = if j = i then 1 else 0

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.eq_sum_basis
entries.snippet: lemma eq_sum_basis (ψ : LeftHandedWeyl) : ψ = ∑ i, ψ.1 i • basis i

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.basis_val
entries.snippet: lemma basis_val (i : Fin 2) : (basis i).val = Pi.single i 1

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep
entries.docstring:
The vector space ℂ^2 carrying the fundamental representation of SL(2,C).
  In index notation corresponds to a Weyl fermion with indices ψ^a.
entries.snippet: def rep : Representation ℂ SL(2,ℂ) LeftHandedWeyl where

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep_apply
entries.snippet: lemma rep_apply (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (ψ : LeftHandedWeyl) : rep M ψ = ⟨M.1 *ᵥ ψ.1⟩

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep_apply_eq_sum_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_apply_eq_sum_basis (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (ψ : LeftHandedWeyl) :
    rep M ψ = ∑ i, (∑ j, M.1 i j * ψ.1 j) • basis i

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep_apply_basis
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_apply_basis (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (i : Fin 2) :
    rep M (basis i) = ∑ j, M.1 j i • basis j

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep_toMatrix
entries.snippet: lemma rep_toMatrix (M : SL(2,ℂ)) : (LinearMap.toMatrix basis basis) (rep M) = M.1

entries.name: Fermion.LeftHandedWeyl.rep_apply_basis_repr
entries.snippet:
lemma rep_apply_basis_repr (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (i j : Fin 2) :

entries.snippet: lemma rep_apply (M : SL(2,ℂ)) (ψ : RightHandedWeyl) : rep M ψ = ⟨M.1.map star *ᵥ ψ.1⟩

entries.name: LorentzGroup.range_toGL
entries.docstring:
The range of `toGL`, as a set in `GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ`, is exactly the preimage of the
Lorentz group under the coercion `GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ → Matrix _ _ ℝ`: an element of the general
linear group lies in the image precisely when its underlying matrix is a Lorentz transformation.
entries.snippet:
lemma range_toGL :
    Set.range (@toGL d).toFun =
      Units.val ⁻¹' (LorentzGroup d : Set (Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ))

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toGL_isClosedEmbedding
entries.docstring:
The homomorphism `toGL` is a closed embedding of the Lorentz group into
`GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ`. This strengthens `toGL_embedding`: the image is closed because it is the
preimage, under the continuous coercion `GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ → Matrix _ _ ℝ`, of the closed set
`LorentzGroup d` (`LorentzGroup.isClosed`).
entries.snippet: lemma toGL_isClosedEmbedding : Topology.IsClosedEmbedding (@toGL d).toFun where

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toGLSubgroup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz group realised as a subgroup of `GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ`, namely the range of the
embedding `toGL`.
entries.snippet: def toGLSubgroup (d : ℕ) : Subgroup (GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ)

entries.name: LorentzGroup.mem_toGLSubgroup
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma mem_toGLSubgroup {x : GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ} :
    x ∈ toGLSubgroup d ↔
      (x : Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) ∈ LorentzGroup d

entries.name: LorentzGroup.coe_toGLSubgroup
entries.snippet:
lemma coe_toGLSubgroup :
    (toGLSubgroup d : Set (GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ)) =
      Units.val ⁻¹' (LorentzGroup d : Set (Matrix (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ))

entries.name: LorentzGroup.toClosedSubgroup
entries.docstring:
The Lorentz group realised as a *closed* subgroup of `GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ`. The closedness is
exactly the content of `toGL_isClosedEmbedding`, and is the hypothesis that the (not-yet-formalised)
closed subgroup theorem would consume to produce a Lie group structure.
entries.snippet: def toClosedSubgroup (d : ℕ) : ClosedSubgroup (GL (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin d) ℝ) where

entries.name: LorentzGroup.exists_boost_mul_rotation
entries.docstring:
Every element of the restricted Lorentz group can be written as a product of a
  generalized boost and a rotation.
entries.snippet:
theorem exists_boost_mul_rotation {d} (Λ : LorentzGroup.restricted d) :
    ∃ (v : Lorentz.Velocity d) (R : Rotations d),
      (Λ : LorentzGroup d) = generalizedBoost 0 v * (R : LorentzGroup d)

lemma conjEquiv_equivariant {c : C} (g : G) (v : V c) :

entries.name: ConjTensorSpecies.conjT_apply

lemma conjT_apply {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (t : S.Tensor c) :

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd
entries.docstring:
Slot-addressed cross contraction: contract slot `i` of `t1` against slot `j` of `t2`. The
  survivors are `t1`'s slots except `i` followed by `t2`'s slots except `j`, so the output color is
  a clean `Fin (nA + nB) → C` and a chain composes without recasts.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def crossToEnd {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j) :
    Tensor S cA →ₗ[k] Tensor S cB →ₗ[k]
      Tensor S (Fin.append (cA ∘ i.succAbove) (cB ∘ j.succAbove))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_two
entries.docstring:
Cross-contracting the last slot of a rank-2 tensor `A` with the `0`-slot of a rank-2 tensor `B`
  is a plain `contrT` of their product on the middle slots `1, 2`, up to a color recast. Discharging
  the slot arithmetic once lets a `contrT`-level identity lift to `crossToEnd` by one rewrite.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_two {cA cB : Fin 2 → C} (h : S.τ (cA (Fin.last 1)) = cB 0)
    (A : Tensor S cA) (B : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) h A B
      = permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr (fun i => by fin_cases i <;> rfl))
          (contrT 2 (1 : Fin 4) (2 : Fin 4)
            (by
              refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
              rw [show (1 : Fin 4) = Fin.castAdd 2 (1 : Fin 2) from rfl,
                  show (2 : Fin 4) = Fin.natAdd 2 (0 : Fin 2) from rfl,
                  Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right]
              exact h)
            (prodT A B))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_equivariant
entries.docstring: Cross contraction is `G`-equivariant, each of `prodT`, `contrT` and `permT` being so.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crossToEnd_equivariant {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1)) (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB j) (g : G)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc (g • t1) (g • t2) = g • crossToEnd i j hc t1 t2

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_assoc_rankTwo
entries.docstring:
Rebracket the chain `A —(iA·0)— B —(last·0)— C` for rank-two `B` and `C`: contracting `A·B`
  first and then `·C` equals contracting `B·C` first and then `A·`, up to the color recast
  `permT id`.

  Not full associativity: only `A`'s attachment slot `iA` is free. `B`'s rank two is what makes the
  statement possible, the second contraction being addressed at `Fin.last nA`, the slot `B`'s unique
  survivor occupies in `A·B`. Other slots are reached by conjugating with the `permT` commutators.

  With `A := T`, `B := g`, `C := g⁻¹` this reassociates `(T·g)·g⁻¹` to `T·(g·g⁻¹)`, after which
  `g·g⁻¹` collapses to the unit tensor: the step behind raising then lowering a named index.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_assoc_rankTwo {nA : ℕ}
    {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cB cC : Fin 2 → C}
    (iA : Fin (nA + 1))
    (hc1 : S.τ (cA iA) = cB 0)
    (hc2 : S.τ (cB (Fin.last 1)) = cC 0)
    (tA : Tensor S cA) (tB : Tensor S cB) (tC : Tensor S cC) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last nA) 0
        (by
          rw [show (Fin.last nA : Fin (nA + 1)) = Fin.natAdd nA (Fin.last 0) from
              Fin.ext (by simp), Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_zero,
            Fin.succ_last]
          exact hc2)
        (crossToEnd iA 0 hc1 tA tB) tC =
      permT id
        (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr fun i => by
          refine Fin.addCases (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) i
          · simp only [Fin.append_left, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_last,
              show a.castSucc = Fin.castAdd 1 a from rfl, Fin.append_left]
          · simp only [Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_zero]
            fin_cases a
            rfl)
        (crossToEnd iA 0
          (by
            rw [show (0 : Fin (1 + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 (0 : Fin 1) from rfl, Fin.append_left,
              Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_last, Fin.castSucc_zero]
            exact hc1)
          tA
          (crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) 0 hc2 tB tC))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_permT_left
entries.docstring:
Left commutator: contracting slot `i` of `permT σ t1` equals contracting slot `σ i` of `t1`,
  then relabelling the survivors by `σ'`. The square `hσ'` records how `σ'` carries the complement
  of `i` to the complement of `σ i`, and implies its bijectivity.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_permT_left {nA nB : ℕ} {cA cA' : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (σ : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1)) (σ' : Fin nA → Fin nA)
    (hσ : IsReindexing cA cA' σ)
    (hσ' : (σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove)
    (hc : S.τ (cA' i) = cB j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc (permT σ hσ t1) t2 =
      permT (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd nB ∘ σ') (Fin.natAdd nA))
        (IsReindexing.append_congr_left (cB ∘ j.succAbove)
          (IsReindexing.succAbove_of_succAbove_eq i hσ hσ'))
        (crossToEnd (σ i) j (by rw [hσ.2 i]; exact hc) t1 t2)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_permT_right
entries.docstring:
Right commutator, the mirror of `crossToEnd_permT_left`: contracting slot `j` of `permT σ t2`
  equals contracting slot `σ j` of `t2`, then relabelling the survivors by `σ'`.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_permT_right {nA nB : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C}
    {cB cB' : Fin (nB + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (σ : Fin (nB + 1) → Fin (nB + 1)) (σ' : Fin nB → Fin nB)
    (hσ : IsReindexing cB cB' σ)
    (hσ' : (σ j).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ j.succAbove)
    (hc : S.τ (cA i) = cB' j)
    (t1 : Tensor S cA) (t2 : Tensor S cB) :
    crossToEnd i j hc t1 (permT σ hσ t2) =
      permT (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd nB) (Fin.natAdd nA ∘ σ'))
        (IsReindexing.append_congr_right (cA ∘ i.succAbove)
          (IsReindexing.succAbove_of_succAbove_eq j hσ hσ'))
        (crossToEnd i (σ j) (by rw [hσ.2 j]; exact hc) t1 t2)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle
entries.docstring:
The survivor color of `crossToEnd i j` against a rank-2 tensor of color `cM` is `c` with
  slot `i` replaced by the surviving color `cM (j.succAbove 0)`, once the survivors are rotated
  back by the inverse of the cycle `[i, last]`.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) :
    IsReindexing
      (Fin.append (c ∘ i.succAbove) (cM ∘ j.succAbove))
      (Function.update c i (cM (j.succAbove 0)))
      ⇑(Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).symm

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot
entries.docstring:
Contract slot `i` of `t` against slot `j` of the rank-2 tensor `M`, whose `j`-slot color must
  equal the dual color `τ (c i)` (propositionally, via `hc`), and rotate `M`'s surviving slot back
  into position `i`. The result is `t` with slot `i` relabelled to `M`'s surviving color.

  This is raising and lowering a named index; the metric case is `j = 0`,
  `M = metricTensor (τ (c i))`. Because `hc` is propositional, a rank-2 tensor whose slot color
  matches only up to an equality enters directly, with no transport.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_eq_crossToEnd
entries.docstring:
The bridge between the two conventions: `crossToSlot i j hc M t` is `crossToEnd i j hc t M`
  with the survivor rotated from the last slot back to slot `i` by the inverse cycle.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlot_eq_crossToEnd {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j) (M : S.Tensor cM) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    crossToSlot i j hc M t =
      permT ⇑(Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).symm (IsReindexing.crossToSlot_cycle i j)
        (crossToEnd i j hc t M)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotInv
entries.docstring:
Contract slot `i` of a tensor whose color there is `d` against `M'`, then absorb the color cast
  the two `Function.update`s generate, landing back on `c`. This is the returning half of a
  raise-then-lower round trip; absorbing the cast here is what keeps the round trip cast-free at
  both ends.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def crossToSlotInv {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {b d e : C} (i : Fin (nA + 1))
    (he : c i = e) (hb : S.τ d = b) (M' : S.Tensor ![b, e]) :
    S.Tensor (Function.update c i d) →ₗ[k] S.Tensor c

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_permT_right_id
entries.docstring:
An identity reindexing of the rank-2 tensor becomes the corresponding identity reindexing of
  the contracted output: the `crossToSlot`-level case of `crossToEnd_permT_right` where the rank-2
  tensor's colors are only propositionally recast.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlot_permT_right_id {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM cM' : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM' j)
    (M : Tensor S cM) (hM : IsReindexing cM cM' (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)) (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot i j hc (permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) hM M) t =
      permT (id : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1))
        (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr (fun a => by
          by_cases ha : a = i
          · subst ha
            simpa using hM.2 (j.succAbove 0)
          · simp [Function.update_of_ne ha]))
        (crossToSlot i j (hc.trans (hM.2 j).symm) M t)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_equivariant
entries.docstring:
Cross contraction into a slot is `G`-equivariant, both constituents (`crossToEnd`, `permT`)
  being so.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma crossToSlot_equivariant {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {cM : Fin 2 → C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin 2) (hc : S.τ (c i) = cM j) (g : G)
    (M : Tensor S cM) (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot i j hc (g • M) (g • t) = g • crossToSlot i j hc M t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.prodT_contrT_fst
entries.docstring:
A contraction internal to the left factor commutes past the outer product with a right
  spectator. The mirror of `prodT_contrT_snd`, obtained from it by `prodT_swap`, so the right-hand
  side contracts the swapped product `prodT t1 t` and carries a block swap.
entries.snippet:
lemma prodT_contrT_fst {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → C}
    {c1 : Fin n1 → C}
    (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j)
    (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT (contrT n i j hij t) t1 =
    permT _ IsReindexing.append_swap
      (permT id (IsReindexing.append_succSuccAbove_natAdd i j) <|
      contrT _
        (Fin.natAdd n1 i)
        (Fin.natAdd n1 j)
        (by simpa using hij) <|
      prodT t1 t)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr
entries.docstring:
Two `permP`–`dropPair`–`dropPair` towers over a common pure tensor agree once their composite
  slot maps agree pointwise. Comparing two orders of dropping two pairs of slots this way keeps
  every slot map an opaque variable, so the comparison closes by unification rather than by
  `whnf`-reducing the color and index-map composites.
entries.snippet:
lemma permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr {nP nOut : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (nP + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1) → C} {cOut : Fin nOut → C} (p : Pure S c)
    (aL bL : Fin (nP + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)) (habL : aL ≠ bL)
    (a2L b2L : Fin (nP + 1 + 1)) (hab2L : a2L ≠ b2L)
    (σ1L : Fin nOut → Fin nP)
    (h1L : IsReindexing ((c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL) ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove a2L b2L) cOut σ1L)
    (aR bR : Fin (nP + 1 + 1 + 1 + 1)) (habR : aR ≠ bR)
    (a2R b2R : Fin (nP + 1 + 1)) (hab2R : a2R ≠ b2R)
    (σ1R : Fin nOut → Fin nP)
    (h1R : IsReindexing ((c ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR) ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove a2R b2R) cOut σ1R)
    (hslot : ∀ m : Fin nOut,
      Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL (Fin.succSuccAbove a2L b2L (σ1L m)) =
      Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR (Fin.succSuccAbove a2R b2R (σ1R m))) :
    permP σ1L h1L (dropPair a2L b2L hab2L (dropPair aL bL habL p)) =
    permP σ1R h1R (dropPair a2R b2R hab2R (dropPair aR bR habR p))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.permP_dropPair_permP_congr
entries.docstring:
Two `permP`–`dropPair`–`permP` towers over a common pure tensor agree once their composite
  slot maps agree pointwise. The one-contraction, inner-relabelled sibling of
  `permP_dropPair_dropPair_congr`.
entries.snippet:
lemma permP_dropPair_permP_congr {nP nOut mL mR : ℕ}
    {c : Fin nP → C} {cL : Fin (mL + 1 + 1) → C} {cR : Fin (mR + 1 + 1) → C}
    {cOut : Fin nOut → C} (p : Pure S c)
    (σ0L : Fin (mL + 1 + 1) → Fin nP) (h0L : IsReindexing c cL σ0L)
    (aL bL : Fin (mL + 1 + 1)) (habL : aL ≠ bL)
    (σ1L : Fin nOut → Fin mL)
    (h1L : IsReindexing (cL ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL) cOut σ1L)
    (σ0R : Fin (mR + 1 + 1) → Fin nP) (h0R : IsReindexing c cR σ0R)
    (aR bR : Fin (mR + 1 + 1)) (habR : aR ≠ bR)
    (σ1R : Fin nOut → Fin mR)
    (h1R : IsReindexing (cR ∘ Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR) cOut σ1R)
    (hslot : ∀ m : Fin nOut,
      σ0L (Fin.succSuccAbove aL bL (σ1L m)) = σ0R (Fin.succSuccAbove aR bR (σ1R m))) :
    permP σ1L h1L (dropPair aL bL habL (permP σ0L h0L p)) =
    permP σ1R h1R (dropPair aR bR habR (permP σ0R h0R p))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.Pure.contrPCoeff_congr
entries.docstring:
`contrPCoeff` is insensitive to its proof arguments once the two contracted slots agree. Lets a
  coefficient comparison rewrite the slots without a `congr` search through the proof fields.
entries.snippet:
lemma contrPCoeff_congr {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (p : Pure S c)
    {i i' j j' : Fin n} (hi : i = i') (hj : j = j')
    {hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ (c i) = c j} {hij' : i' ≠ j' ∧ S.τ (c i') = c j'} :
    p.contrPCoeff i j hij = p.contrPCoeff i' j' hij'

entries.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_castAdd
entries.docstring:
Reinserting a left-block survivor `a` after removing the `i`-th slot of the left block and the
  `j`-th slot of the right block of `Fin ((nA + 1) + (nB + 1))`, the removal read at the contracted
  length `(nA + nB) + 1 + 1`. Unlike `succSuccAbove_natAdd_apply_castAdd` the two holes straddle the
  two blocks, so the statement carries the reshaping `Fin.cast`s.
entries.snippet:
lemma succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_castAdd {nA nB : ℕ} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (a : Fin nA) :
    Fin.cast (show (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 = (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) by omega)
        ((Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.castAdd (nB + 1) i)).succSuccAbove
          (Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.natAdd (nA + 1) j)) (Fin.castAdd nB a))
      = Fin.castAdd (nB + 1) (i.succAbove a)

entries.name: Fin.succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_natAdd
entries.docstring:
Reinserting a right-block survivor, the mirror of
  `Fin.succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_castAdd`.
entries.snippet:
lemma succSuccAbove_castAdd_natAdd_apply_natAdd {nA nB : ℕ} (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (j : Fin (nB + 1))
    (a : Fin nB) :
    Fin.cast (show (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 = (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) by omega)
        ((Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.castAdd (nB + 1) i)).succSuccAbove
          (Fin.cast (show (nA + 1) + (nB + 1) = (nA + nB) + 1 + 1 by omega)
            (Fin.natAdd (nA + 1) j)) (Fin.natAdd nA a))
      = Fin.natAdd (nA + 1) (j.succAbove a)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_prodT_unitTensor
entries.docstring:
Cross-contracting the last slot of the product `E ⊗ B` (with `B` rank one) against the unit
  tensor for that slot's color returns `E ⊗ B` unchanged, the contracted slot carried to the end.
  The rank-one spectator case that seeds `crossToEnd_unitTensor_slot`.
entries.snippet:
private lemma crossToEnd_prodT_unitTensor {nV : ℕ} {cE : Fin nV → C} {cB : C}
    (E : Tensor S cE) (B : Tensor S ![cB]) :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last nV) (0 : Fin 2)
        (by rw [show (Fin.last nV : Fin (nV + 1)) = Fin.natAdd nV 0 from Fin.ext (by simp)]; simp :
          S.τ ((Fin.append cE ![cB]) (Fin.last nV)) = ![S.τ cB, cB] 0)
        (prodT E B) (unitTensor cB) =
      permT id (IsReindexing.on_id.mpr (fun i => by
        refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
        · simp only [Fin.append_left, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_last]
          exact (Fin.append_left cE ![cB] j).symm
        · simp only [Fin.append_right, Function.comp_apply, Fin.succAbove_zero]
          fin_cases j
          rfl)) (prodT E B)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_unitTensor_slot
entries.docstring:
The boundary case of `crossToEnd_unitTensor`, proved by spectator decomposition along the last
  slot (`eq_sum_evalT`). The last slot is threaded as a variable `i` with `hilast : i = last nA` so
  that `crossToEnd_unitTensor` can apply it at the image of `i` under its transposition without a
  dependent rewrite of the slot index.
entries.snippet:
private lemma crossToEnd_unitTensor_slot {nA : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {c : C}
    {i : Fin (nA + 1)} (hilast : i = Fin.last nA) (hc : cA i = c) (t1 : Tensor S cA) :
    crossToEnd i (0 : Fin 2) (by simp [hc] : S.τ (cA i) = ![S.τ c, c] 0) t1 (unitTensor c) =
      permT (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i)) (IsReindexing.move_last i hc) t1

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_unitTensor
entries.docstring:
Contracting slot `i` of `t1` against the unit tensor for that slot's color returns `t1`, the
  contracted slot relabelled by `move_last i`. The unit tensor acts as an identity for `crossToEnd`
  at any named slot.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_unitTensor {nA : ℕ} {cA : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {c : C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (hc : cA i = c) (t1 : Tensor S cA) :
    crossToEnd i (0 : Fin 2) (by simp [hc] : S.τ (cA i) = ![S.τ c, c] 0) t1 (unitTensor c) =
      permT (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i)) (IsReindexing.move_last i hc) t1

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair
entries.docstring:
The color list `crossToEnd` produces from a matched rank-2 pair `M : ![a, d]`, `M' : ![b, e]` is
  the color list `![S.τ e, e]` of `unitTensor e`, via the identity slot map: the reindexing carried
  by the collapse hypothesis `M · M' = δ` of the round trips below. Only the surviving colors `a`
  and `e` enter, and `a` equals `S.τ e` only propositionally, so a pair whose colors match
  propositionally enters with no transport.
entries.snippet:
lemma IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair {a b d e : C} (h : S.τ e = a) :
    IsReindexing (![S.τ e, e] : Fin 2 → C)
      (Fin.append ((![a, d] : Fin 2 → C) ∘ (Fin.last 1).succAbove)
        ((![b, e] : Fin 2 → C) ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove))
      (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_round_trip_of_unit_slot
entries.docstring:
Round trip of two contractions against a matched pair, in result-to-end form. Contracting slot
  `i` of `t` against `M₁`, then contracting the surviving `M₁`-index (deposited at slot `j`) against
  `M₂`, returns `t` up to the cycle that moves the round-tripped slot from the end back to `i`,
  whenever `M₁` and `M₂` collapse to the unit tensor. The last slot is threaded as a variable `j`
  with `hj : j = last nA` so that a caller can apply it at a propositionally-last slot without a
  dependent rewrite of the slot index.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_round_trip_of_unit_slot {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {d : C}
    (i j : Fin (nA + 1)) (hj : j = Fin.last nA)
    (M₁ : Tensor S ![S.τ (c i), d]) (M₂ : Tensor S ![S.τ d, c i])
    (hM : crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) rfl M₁ M₂ =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair rfl)
        (unitTensor (S := S) (c i)))
    (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToEnd j (0 : Fin 2)
        (by subst hj
            rw [show (Fin.last nA : Fin (nA + 1)) = Fin.natAdd nA (0 : Fin 1) from
                  Fin.ext (by simp), Fin.append_right]; rfl)
        (crossToEnd i (0 : Fin 2) rfl t M₁) M₂ =
      permT (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i))
        (by
          subst hj
          exact ⟨by
            rw [Fin.append_succAbove_const_eq_cycleIcc i]
            exact (Fin.cycleIcc i (Fin.last nA)).bijective,
          fun x => by
            refine Fin.addCases (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) x
            · simp only [Function.comp_apply, Fin.append_left, Fin.succAbove_last,
                show (Fin.castSucc a : Fin (nA + 1)) = Fin.castAdd 1 a from rfl]
            · fin_cases a
              simp [Fin.append_right, Fin.succAbove_zero]⟩)
        t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_round_trip_of_unit
entries.docstring:
Round trip for `crossToSlot` at an arbitrary slot, with the colors in their composite form.
  The general-color statement `crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip` is obtained from this by
  substituting its three color equalities.
entries.snippet:
private lemma crossToSlot_round_trip_of_unit {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {d : C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1))
    (M₁ : Tensor S ![S.τ (c i), d]) (M₂ : Tensor S ![S.τ d, c i])
    (hM : crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) rfl M₁ M₂ =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair rfl)
        (unitTensor (S := S) (c i)))
    (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot (S := S) i (0 : Fin 2)
        (by rw [Function.update_self] : S.τ (Function.update c i d i) = S.τ d) M₂
        (crossToSlot (S := S) i (0 : Fin 2) rfl M₁ t) =
      permT (id : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1)) (IsReindexing.update_update_of_eq i rfl) t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip
entries.docstring:
Raising then lowering a named index, with every color threaded propositionally. For a rank-2
  metric `M : ![a, d]` and an inverse `M' : ![b, e]` collapsing to the unit tensor (`M · M' = δ`),
  at any rank and any slot `i`: contracting slot `i` with `M`, then contracting the result with
  `M'`, is the identity up to the `Function.update` color reindex.

  No color is pinned to a composite. `ha : τ (c i) = a` places the metric's contracted slot,
  `hb : τ d = b` the inverse's, and `he : c i = e` the surviving one, so a caller whose metric and
  inverse sit at literal colors supplies them directly, with no transporting `permT` on either
  factor. Lowering then raising is this same statement with `M` and `M'` exchanged and the reversed
  collapse `M' · M = δ`; neither collapse follows from the other here.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip {nA : ℕ} {c : Fin (nA + 1) → C} {a b d e : C}
    (i : Fin (nA + 1)) (he : c i = e) (ha : S.τ (c i) = a) (hb : S.τ d = b)
    (M : Tensor S ![a, d]) (M' : Tensor S ![b, e])
    (hM : crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) hb M M' =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)
        (IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair ((congrArg S.τ he.symm).trans ha))
        (unitTensor (S := S) e))
    (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlot (S := S) i (0 : Fin 2)
        (by rw [Function.update_self]; exact hb : S.τ (Function.update c i d i) = b) M'
        (crossToSlot (S := S) i (0 : Fin 2) ha M t) =
      permT (id : Fin (nA + 1) → Fin (nA + 1)) (IsReindexing.update_update_of_eq i he) t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotInv_crossToSlot
entries.docstring:
Lowering undoes raising: `crossToSlot_raise_lower_round_trip` with the color cast absorbed into
  `crossToSlotInv`.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlotInv_crossToSlot (t : Tensor S c) :
    crossToSlotInv i he hb M' (crossToSlot i (0 : Fin 2) ha M t) = t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlot_crossToSlotInv
entries.docstring:
Raising undoes lowering. The reversed collapse `M' · M = δ` is the round trip at the color
  list `Function.update c i d` with the pair exchanged, which gives the lowering half a left
  inverse and hence injectivity; that upgrades `crossToSlotInv_crossToSlot` to a two-sided
  inverse.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToSlot_crossToSlotInv (t : Tensor S (Function.update c i d)) :
    crossToSlot i (0 : Fin 2) ha M (crossToSlotInv i he hb M' t) = t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToSlotEquiv
entries.docstring:
Raising and lowering a named index against a mutually inverse pair, as a linear equivalence: the
  two color assignments `c` and `Function.update c i d` carry the same tensors. `M` and `M'` are
  matched only propositionally and `d` is unrelated to `c i`, so this covers a metric pairing two
  unrelated colors as well as a metric and its inverse at `S.τ (c i)`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def crossToSlotEquiv : Tensor S c ≃ₗ[k] Tensor S (Function.update c i d)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex
entries.docstring:
The linear map between `S.Tensor c` and `S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))`
  formed by contracting the index `i` with the metric tensor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toDualMapAtIndex : {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) →
    S.Tensor c →ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))
  | 0, _, i => i.elim0
  | _ + 1, c, i => crossToSlot i (0 : Fin 2) rfl (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ (c i)))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor
entries.docstring:
The metric tensor at `S.τ c` contracted with the metric tensor at `c` is the unit tensor
  at `c`.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor {c : C} :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) (S.τ_τ_apply c) (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ c))
        (metricTensor (S := S) c) =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair rfl) (unitTensor (S := S) c)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.crossToEnd_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit
entries.docstring:
The metric tensor at `c` contracted with the metric tensor at `S.τ c` is the unit tensor
  at `S.τ c`.
entries.snippet:
lemma crossToEnd_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit {c : C} :
    crossToEnd (Fin.last 1) (0 : Fin 2) rfl (metricTensor (S := S) c)
        (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ c)) =
      permT (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) (IsReindexing.unitTensor_pair (S.τ_τ_apply c))
        (unitTensor (S := S) (S.τ c))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex
entries.docstring:
Dualising the index `i` twice returns the original tensor, up to the reindexing of the
  colors.
entries.snippet:
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C}
    (i : Fin n) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t) =
      permT (id : Fin n → Fin n)
        (IsReindexing.update_update_of_eq i (by simp [τ_τ_apply])) t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromDualMapAtIndex
entries.docstring:
The linear map between `S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))` and `S.Tensor c`
  formed by contracting the index `i` with the metric tensor. It is the inverse of
  `toDualMapAtIndex`.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def fromDualMapAtIndex : {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) →
    S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i))) →ₗ[k] S.Tensor c
  | 0, _, i => i.elim0
  | _ + 1, c, i => crossToSlotInv i rfl (S.τ_τ_apply (c i)) (metricTensor (S := S) (c i))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.fromDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma fromDualMapAtIndex_toDualMapAtIndex {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    fromDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t) = t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_fromDualMapAtIndex
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_fromDualMapAtIndex {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n)
    (t : S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))) :
    toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (fromDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t) = t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualMapAtIndex_equivariant
entries.docstring: Dualising the index `i` commutes with the action of `G`.
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toDualMapAtIndex_equivariant {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n) (g : G) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i (g • t) = g • toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex
entries.docstring:
The linear equivalence between `S.Tensor c` and `S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))`
  formed by contracting the index `i` with the metric tensor.
entries.snippet:
noncomputable def toDualAtIndex : {n : ℕ} → {c : Fin n → C} → (i : Fin n) →
    S.Tensor c ≃ₗ[k] S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))
  | 0, _, i => i.elim0
  | _ + 1, c, i =>
    crossToSlotEquiv i rfl rfl (S.τ_τ_apply (c i)) (metricTensor (S := S) (S.τ (c i)))
      (metricTensor (S := S) (c i)) crossToEnd_dual_metricTensor_metricTensor
      crossToEnd_metricTensor_metricTensor_eq_dual_unit

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toDualAtIndex_apply {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n) (t : S.Tensor c) :
    toDualAtIndex (S := S) i t = toDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.toDualAtIndex_symm_apply
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma toDualAtIndex_symm_apply {n : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} (i : Fin n)
    (t : S.Tensor (Function.update c i (S.τ (c i)))) :
    (toDualAtIndex (S := S) i).symm t = fromDualMapAtIndex (S := S) i t

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.indexExprIsJiggle
entries.docstring: Bool which is true if an index is a jiggle `τ(i)`.
entries.snippet: def indexExprIsJiggle (stx : Syntax) : Bool

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.indexRemoveTau
entries.docstring:
Removes a `τ(⬝)` wrapper from an index, leaving any other index unchanged. Pure, so it can be
  used to compare indices up to `τ` (e.g. when counting contractions in `withoutContrEval`).
entries.snippet: def indexRemoveTau (stx : TSyntax `indexExpr) : TSyntax `indexExpr

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.getJigglePos
entries.docstring:
Returns the positions of indices which are "jiggled", i.e., of the form `τ(μ)`,
  these are the indices which are to be raised or lowered.
entries.snippet: def getJigglePos (ind : List (TSyntax `indexExpr)) : TermElabM (List ℕ)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorExpressionOperator
entries.docstring:
A Tensor expression operator is a map which takes in a pair
  consisting of a list of indices and a term and outputs a list of indices and a term,
  after applying a certain operation.
entries.snippet: abbrev TensorExpressionOperator

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorExpressionOperator.create
entries.docstring: The creation of a tensor from a syntax tree.
entries.snippet:
def TensorExpressionOperator.create (stx : Syntax) :
    TermElabM (List (TSyntax `indexExpr) × Term)

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorExpressionOperator.jiggle
entries.docstring:
The tensor expression operator which rises or lowers the indices of a tensor based on
  indices with `τ`-syntax.
entries.snippet: def TensorExpressionOperator.jiggle : TensorExpressionOperator

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorExpressionOperator.eval
entries.docstring: The tensor expression operator which evaluates indices.
entries.snippet: def TensorExpressionOperator.eval : TensorExpressionOperator

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorExpressionOperator.contr
entries.docstring: The tensor expression operator which contracts indices.
entries.snippet: def TensorExpressionOperator.contr : TensorExpressionOperator

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.TensorExpressionOperator.prod
entries.docstring: The tensor expression operator which takes the product of two tensors.
entries.snippet:
def TensorExpressionOperator.prod : List (TSyntax `indexExpr) × Term →

entries.docstring: Commuting evaluation with permutations.

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.contrT_evalT
entries.docstring:
Commuting evaluation with contraction. Evaluating index `k` and then contracting the
  pair `i j` equals contracting the corresponding pair `k.succAbove i`, `k.succAbove j` and
  then evaluating the residual index, up to the identity reindexing
  `IsReindexing.succAbove_succSuccAbove_comm`.
entries.snippet:
lemma contrT_evalT {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1) → C}
    (k : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + 1)) (i j : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) (φ : basisIdx (c k))
    (hij : i ≠ j ∧ S.τ ((c ∘ k.succAbove) i) = (c ∘ k.succAbove) j) (t : Tensor S c) :
    contrT n i j hij (evalT k φ t) =
    permT id (.succAbove_succSuccAbove_comm k i j hij.1)
      (evalT (Fin.predPredAbove (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) (by simp [hij.1]) k (by simp))
        (basisIdxCongr (by simp) φ)
        (contrT (n + 1) (k.succAbove i) (k.succAbove j) ⟨by simp [hij.1], hij.2⟩ t))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.evalT_prodT_right
entries.docstring:
Evaluating an index in the right factor of a tensor product commutes with forming the
  product, up to the identity reindexing which identifies the two ways of removing that
  index from the appended color list.
entries.snippet:
lemma evalT_prodT_right {n n1 : ℕ} {c : Fin n → C} {c1 : Fin (n1 + 1) → C}
    (i : Fin (n1 + 1)) (x : basisIdx (c1 i)) (t : Tensor S c) (t1 : Tensor S c1) :
    prodT t (evalT i x t1) =
    permT id (IsReindexing.append_succAbove_natAdd (n := n) (n1 := n1) i)
      (evalT (Fin.natAdd (m := n1 + 1) n i) (basisIdxCongr (by simp) x) (prodT t t1))

entries.snippet:

entries.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_zero
entries.docstring:
**Full Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction** `∑_b (ε4)_b · (ε4)_b = 24` at the symbol level:
summing the square of every standard-basis component of `ε4` over all four `Fin 4` index slots,
paired naively (no metric), counts the `4! = 24` permutations. The Lorentz contraction
`ε^{μνρσ} ε_{μνρσ}` lowers one factor with `η` and equals `-24` instead.
entries.snippet:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_zero :
    ∑ g : (Fin 4 → Fin 4), euclidLeviCivita g * euclidLeviCivita g = 24

entries.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one
entries.docstring:
**Triple Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction** `∑_h (ε4)_{a,h} · (ε4)_{b,h} = 6 · δ[a,b]` at
the symbol level: contracting three of the four `Fin 4` component slots of `ε4` with the naive
Kronecker pairing leaves one free pair `a, b` and the factor `3! = 6`. The Lorentz form carries
an extra `det η = -1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_one (a b : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 3 → Fin 4, euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons a h) * euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons b h)
      = 6 * ((kroneckerDelta a b : ℕ) : ℝ)

entries.name: euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_two
entries.docstring:
**Double Euclidean Levi-Civita contraction**
`∑_h (ε4)_{r,s,h} · (ε4)_{t,w,h} = 2 · (δ[r,t]·δ[s,w] - δ[r,w]·δ[s,t])` at the symbol level:
contracting two of the four `Fin 4` component slots of `ε4` with the naive Kronecker pairing
leaves two free pairs and the factor `2! = 2`. The Lorentz form carries an extra `det η = -1`.
entries.snippet:
lemma euclidLeviCivita_symbol_contract_two (r s t w : Fin 4) :
    ∑ h : Fin 2 → Fin 4, euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons r (Fin.cons s h))
          * euclidLeviCivita (Fin.cons t (Fin.cons w h))
      = 2 * (((kroneckerDelta r t : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((kroneckerDelta s w : ℕ) : ℝ)
          - ((kroneckerDelta r w : ℕ) : ℝ) * ((kroneckerDelta s t : ℕ) : ℝ))

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.succAbove_of_succAbove_eq
entries.docstring:
The conclusion of `succAbove` from an explicit survivor relabelling: if `σ'` fills the square
  `(σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove`, carrying the complement of `i` to the complement of
  `σ i`, then it is a reindexing of the two shortened colour lists. The square forces `σ'` to be
  injective, hence bijective, so no bijectivity hypothesis is needed; this is why the statement is
  restricted to equal lengths.

  Where `succAbove` builds the relabelling from `σ` as a `dite` composite, the map here is the
  caller's, which is what lets it stand in the statement of a lemma the caller instantiates.
entries.snippet:
lemma succAbove_of_succAbove_eq {n : ℕ} {c c1 : Fin (n + 1) → C}
    {σ : Fin (n + 1) → Fin (n + 1)} {σ' : Fin n → Fin n} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (h : IsReindexing c c1 σ) (hσ' : (σ i).succAbove ∘ σ' = σ ∘ i.succAbove) :
    IsReindexing (c ∘ (σ i).succAbove) (c1 ∘ i.succAbove) σ'

entries.name: TensorSpecies.Tensor.IsReindexing.move_last
entries.docstring:
Splitting a list of colours `c : Fin (n + 1) → C` at an arbitrary slot `i`, rather than at the
  last one as in `append_succ_last`: the block map that lists the `i.succAbove` survivors and then
  `i` itself matches `c` with the survivors of `i` followed by the surviving entry `c1 1` of a
  rank-two list `c1` whose second entry is slot `i`'s colour.
entries.snippet:
lemma move_last {n : ℕ} {c : Fin (n + 1) → C} {c1 : Fin 2 → C} (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hc : c i = c1 1) :
    IsReindexing c
      (Fin.append (c ∘ i.succAbove) (c1 ∘ (0 : Fin 2).succAbove))
      (Fin.append i.succAbove (fun _ : Fin 1 => i))

  over `B` into one over `B'` by placing each exponent at its image. For an embedding

  dimension in one system re-expresses faithfully in an extending one.

entries.name: Dimension.Embedding
entries.docstring:
A **dimension embedding** `B ↪ B'`: an injective monoid homomorphism of
  dimensions. As a `MonoidHom` it is dimension-preserving (it respects products,
  inverses and rational powers); injectivity makes it a faithful inclusion of the basis
  `B` into `B'`. Cross-basis dimension injections are produced as `Embedding`s so that
  dimension-preservation holds by construction.
entries.snippet:
structure Embedding (B B' : Type) where
  toHom : Dimension B →* Dimension B'
  inj : Function.Injective toHom

entries.name: Dimension.Projection
entries.docstring:
A **dimension projection** `B' ↠ B`: a surjective monoid homomorphism of
  dimensions. As a `MonoidHom` it is truth-preserving, but it is lossy — it reduces a
  richer basis `B'` onto a coarser basis `B`, collapsing the base dimensions that `B`
  does not track.
entries.snippet:
structure Projection (B' B : Type) where
  toHom : Dimension B' →* Dimension B
  surj : Function.Surjective toHom

entries.name: Dimension.Embedding.ofBasis

An injective *basis* map `f : B → B'` induces a dimension embedding, via `extend`.
  This is the label-level case: it sends each base dimension of `B` to a base dimension
  of `B'`, so it is automatically dimension-preserving and faithful.
entries.snippet:
def Embedding.ofBasis {B B' : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B']

The ISQ dimensions project onto PhysLib's, reading current as charge/time and
  forgetting amount of substance and luminous intensity.
entries.snippet: def isqToLTMCT : Projection ISQDimensionBase LTMCTDimensionBase where

entries.name: Dimension.isqToLTMCT_comp_ltmctToISQ
entries.docstring:
The projection is a retraction of the embedding: `isqToLTMCT ∘ ltmctToISQ = id`. So
  PhysLib's basis embeds faithfully into ISQ and is recovered by the projection, but not
  conversely — amount of substance and luminous intensity cannot be recovered.
entries.snippet:
lemma isqToLTMCT_comp_ltmctToISQ :
    isqToLTMCT.toHom.comp ltmctToISQ.toHom = MonoidHom.id (Dimension LTMCTDimensionBase)

entries.name: Dimension.toISQHom_C𝓭
entries.docstring:
The embedding is physically faithful on charge: PhysLib's charge generator `C𝓭`
  maps to the *derived* ISQ charge `I · T`.
entries.snippet: lemma toISQHom_C𝓭 : toISQHom C𝓭 = ISQDimensionBase.charge

entries.name: ISQDimensionBase
entries.docstring:
The seven ISQ base quantities (ISO/IEC 80000-1; VIM 3rd edition). Unlike
  `LTMCTDimensionBase`, electric current is the electromagnetic base quantity (so
  charge is derived), and amount of substance and luminous intensity are further
  base quantities.
entries.snippet:
inductive ISQDimensionBase where
  | length
  | mass
  | time
  | current
  | temperature
  | amount
  | luminousIntensity

entries.name: ISQDimensionBase.card_eq_seven
entries.docstring: The ISQ has seven base quantities.
entries.snippet: lemma card_eq_seven : Fintype.card ISQDimensionBase = 7

entries.name: ISQDimensionBase.charge

entries.name: ISQDimensionBase.charge_exponent_time

entries.name: ISQDimensionBase.charge_exponent_mass

entries.name: UnitScale
entries.docstring:
A choice of unit for each base dimension of `B`: a positive-real magnitude per
  base. This is the basis-generic form of `UnitChoices`.
entries.snippet:
structure UnitScale (B : Type) where
  scale : B → ℝ≥0
  scale_pos : ∀ b, 0 < scale b

entries.name: UnitScale.ratio_ne_zero
entries.snippet: lemma ratio_ne_zero (u1 u2 : UnitScale B) (b : B) : u1.scale b / u2.scale b ≠ 0

entries.name: UnitScale.dimScale
entries.docstring:
The dimension-scaling homomorphism, generic in the basis `B`: a quantity of
  dimension `d` rescales by `∏ b, (u1 b / u2 b) ^ d.exponent b` when changing the
  unit choice from `u1` to `u2`. This is the basis-generic form of
  `UnitChoices.dimScale`.
entries.snippet: noncomputable def dimScale [Fintype B] (u1 u2 : UnitScale B) : Dimension B →* ℝ≥0 where

entries.name: UnitScale.dimScale_self
entries.snippet:
@[simp]

    dimScale u u d = 1

entries.name: UnitScale.dimScale_one
entries.snippet:
@[simp]
lemma dimScale_one [Fintype B] (u1 u2 : UnitScale B) :
    dimScale u1 u2 1 = 1

entries.name: UnitScale.dimScale_transitive
entries.docstring: The scaling is transitive (a cocycle in the unit choices).
entries.snippet:
lemma dimScale_transitive [Fintype B] (u1 u2 u3 : UnitScale B) (d : Dimension B) :
    dimScale u1 u2 d * dimScale u2 u3 d = dimScale u1 u3 d
